scripts.cap:init: npx cap init HollyPolly com.hollypolly.app --web-dir www
scripts.mobile:dev: echo 'Starting dev server for Capacitor...' && next dev --turbopack
scripts.deploy: git add -A && git commit -m 'deploy' --allow-empty && git push origin main
scripts.clean:build: echo '🧹 Cleaning caches...' && rm -rf .next node_modules/.cache ios/App/App/public ios/DerivedData ios/App/Pods && yarn cache clean && echo '📲 Clearing iOS Simulator caches...' && xcrun simctl shutdown all 2>/dev/null; rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices/*/data/Containers/Data/Application/*/Library/WebKit 2>/dev/null; rm -rf ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices/*/data/Containers/Data/Application/*/Library/Caches 2>/dev/null; echo '📦 Installing dependencies...' && yarn install && echo '🔄 Syncing Capacitor iOS...' && npx cap sync ios && echo '🍎 Opening Xcode...' && npx cap open ios && echo '✅ Done! Build & run from Xcode.'
